## Type of change

- [ ] `docs`: documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] Linked to an issue
- [ ] The branch is up to date with its target branch
- [ ] CI is green (lint, tests, build)
- [ ] New code is covered by tests
- [ ] Documentation is updated (user and/or technical), and an ADR is added or updated if a significant decision changed
- [ ] No secrets, dead code or unused files
- [ ] Hidden information is never sent to the player view (when relevant)
- [ ] Accessibility checked for UI changes: keyboard, screen reader, contrast, not color alone, reduced motion, touch targets
- [ ] AI usage, if any, is declared in the README and I can explain every part of the code
- [ ] Third-party assets and content respect their licenses and are credited
